summary: The root نكف (nkf) primarily means to abstain from or refuse something due to disdain or pride. It implies a sense of haughtiness in declining an action or object.
lane: 1 نَكِفَ مِنَالشَّىْءِ ذ , aor. نَكَفَ ; inf. n. نَكَفٌ ; and نَكَفَ , aor. نَكُفَ ; and ; He abstained from, or refused to do, the thing, from disdain and pride. (Msb.)
